About.title: Our Story
About.p1: Suradiq was born from a desire to return to the roots of true craftsmanship. In an era of mass-produced, fast-furniture, we chose a different path—one that honors the material, respects the maker, and ultimately elevates the home.
About.p2: We focus on modern minimalism, believing that a piece of furniture should not overwhelm a space, but rather anchor it. Every table, sofa, and chair we produce is bespoke, carved by experienced hands using only the most premium, sustainably sourced woods, metals, and leathers.

Contact.title: Get in touch
Contact.desc: Whether you have a question about a bespoke order, materials, or delivery schedules, our concierge team is ready to assist you.

details.replyTime: We aim to reply within 24 hours.

q1.a: Yes, we ship globally on a case-by-case basis. Because of the size and weight of our furniture, international freight is calculated manually. Please reach out to our concierge for a quote.

q2.q: Can I customize the dimensions of a table?
q2.a: Absolutely. We are a bespoke furniture manufacturer. While our catalog offers standard sizes that fit most rooms, we can adjust dimensions. Contact us directly to begin a bespoke commission.

q3.a: Our standard lead time is 4-8 weeks. Every piece is hand-finished and inspected rigorously to ensure it meets the Suradiq standard before it leaves our workshop.

q4.q: How should I care for my solid oak furniture?
q4.a: We recommend avoiding direct, intense sunlight and extreme humidity changes. Clean spills immediately with a damp cloth, and use a premium beeswax polish every six months to keep the wood nourished.
